paper_title: Requisite variety: why an AI system needs as many responses as it has kinds of trouble
paper_frame: Ashby's law of requisite variety says a regulator can only hold its outcomes steady if it can answer each kind of disturbance with a fitting response. An AI system that meets every failure with the same retry has one response. We state the law as checks on this system's own records: does every loop have a way to close, does every failure get its own repair item, and does the second loop actually add new responses.
title: An Introduction to Cybernetics
data: Theory. Part III, Regulation and Control; chapter 11 states the law of requisite variety.
summary: Only variety in the regulator can absorb variety in the disturbances. If the environment can throw more kinds of trouble at a system than the system has distinct responses, some outcomes will leave their limits no matter how well each response is tuned.
limits: We state the law in our own words from chapter 11. We do not count disturbance classes directly; we read proxies from the loop registry, the second loop's log and the deploy ledger.
A declared closing probe is a response on paper. The deploy check is the only reading here that shows a response worked live.

misperception.belief: A capable enough model can handle any failure by trying again.
misperception.counter: A retry is one response. A system facing many kinds of failure needs many kinds of response, and needs a way to grow new ones. That is Ashby's law, and it can be read from the system's own records.

findings.concern: A loop with no response at all
findings.claim: A loop that has no closing probe and no server-side owner contributes no variety: nothing in it answers a disturbance. Every registered loop should carry both.

mechanisms.how: every loop declares a closing probe and a server owner

findings.concern: A regulator that never adds a response
findings.claim: When the first loop's responses are not enough, the system has to gain new ones. Here that is the second loop changing a parameter. If it never steps, the system's variety is fixed at whatever it was built with.

mechanisms.how: reads unregulated disturbance classes from the work queue
steps a parameter when a variable stays out of limits

findings.concern: A response that is never checked against the world
findings.claim: Variety only counts if the response actually lands. A deploy that is not read back live may be a response that did nothing.

mechanisms.how: every item names a live closing probe
